result.title: What, Who, and When: Structured Harm Assessment for Mental Health Safety via Short Reasoning
result.summary: The growing use of large language models (LLMs) for mental health support raises important safety concerns. Existing guard models primarily identify categories of harmful content, often overlooking the context needed to determine an appropriate response. We introduce a clinically grounded taxonomy that characterizes harm along three dimensions: what the harm is, who is involved, and when it occurs. It further separates harm characterization from intervention decisions, thus enabling safety policies to be specified outside the model weights through explicit, clinician-curated instructions that can be updated and audited. We validate the taxonomy with expert clinicians and validate a panel of LLM judges to scale annotation. Relabeling public benchmarks in this taxonomy shows that they rarely contain harm directed at the user, which accounts for nearly half of the harm in real conversations. We then train MindGuard2, a 35B-A3B reasoning-based guard model using supervised fine-tuning on short reasoning traces followed by reinforcement learning with a reasoning-length penalty, to minimize inference overhead while preserving the benefits of reasoning. On two public benchmarks and real-world conversations, MindGuard2 achieves balanced accuracy comparable to the substantially larger GLM-5.3 at approximately 10x lower median latency, advancing the accuracy-latency Pareto frontier. Furthermore, it achieves low false-positive rates at high recall, helping balance the need to detect unsafe situations against the risk of unnecessary interventions that may disrupt support and undermine user trust. We release a safety guardrail model with SOTA performance trained on synthetic data, together with synthetic conversations and annotations of public benchmarks in our taxonomy.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出临床取向的心理健康危害分类法，沿「危害是什么、涉及谁、何时发生」三维刻画危害并与干预决策分离，再以短推理轨迹 SFT 加带推理长度惩罚的 RL 训练 35B-A3B 的 guard 模型 MindGuard2，在保持推理收益的同时压低推理开销。
AI.relevance_reason: 其中「短推理轨迹 + 长度惩罚的 RL」为推理预算与停止决策提供了可核查的训练监督线索，可能对应 LVR 中 THINK/STOP 的收益-成本权衡与长度泛化；但属纯文本安全分类任务，无视觉状态或证据获取，迁移仅为推测。
